name: Docker Hub v2 API
tier_rationale: Docker, Inc. is an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P102 cond 1 'Registry provider docker_hub: tier trusted' and P359 cond 3 'Docker trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the accounts, repositories and image metadata it hosts; profile fields and image LABEL e-mails are self-asserted, and labels inherited from base images are ignored (P102 cond 4).

hub_api.title: Docker Hub v2 API (users, orgs, repositories, tags, image layer instructions)

terms.quote: Registry provider docker_hub: tier trusted, terms open.

hub_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P102 cond 1); research C0234 terms '[gh_people] Docker Hub ToS; public API' (verified_live 200). The Docker Terms of Use (checked 2026-11-26) govern unauthenticated 'Free Hub Access' and allow automated access 'through documented APIs and within published limits'. hub.docker.com/v2/users/{u} (308 -> /v2/orgs/{o}), /v2/orgs/{o}, /v2/repositories/{ns}/?page_size<=100, .../{repo}/tags and .../tags/{tag}/images (layer instructions); <= 5 repositories, latest tag, 1 page (P102 cond 3). 404 {'message':'User not found'} = ABSENT; 429 = RATE_LIMITED. Used by dockerhub, username_check and org_code_footprint.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G05-2, p2-G05-1, p2-G05-2 (P102, P113, P359): batches only extend it (docker_hub__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). hub.docker.com v2 API only: registry-1.docker.io and auth.docker.io are never contacted (anonymous pull limits are shared by the corporate NAT and its CI; P102 cond 2). Observed x-ratelimit-limit 180 per window (research C0234): the headers are honoured and 429 = RATE_LIMITED, so no quota block. ttl 7 days (P102 cond 3). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (P102 cond 6); secrets in layer instructions pass the P145/P323 sanitizer at module level (P102 cond 5).
